areas.t: Thursday, mostly sunny skies and temperatures in the low- to mid-80s will support ozone development across Louisiana. Additionally, calm to light easterly winds will inhibit pollutant dispersion over much of the state, while smoke from regional agricultural fires will contribute to particle levels.
